dog.description_text:
Marie Laveau came to us from Alabama, where she was at risk due to her medical condition. Born with Microphthalmia, her left eye is very small and does not function - but you would never know it by the way she lives her life. She is playful, affectionate, happy, and full of love.

She was once adopted and had a home of her own, but sadly was recently returned because her family no longer had the time for her. Through it all, Marie Laveau has remained incredibly sweet and trusting.

She deserves more than being overlooked because she is “different.” She deserves a family who sees how truly special she is - a dog who loves deeply, plays joyfully, and just wants someone to love her forever.

Marie Laveau has already overcome so much. Now she just needs the person who will finally choose her for life.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption. Please note that the listed location for this dog may not be accurate due to technical limitations of this database and we have transportation options available within 6 hours of NYC (so don't let location hold you back)!

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.

Adoption application: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/general-application/

Foster application: https://www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/dog-foster-application/

Adoption process & fees: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/process/

For a full list of our available dogs and current adoption promotions, visit: https://nycsecondchancerescue.org/adoptable-dogs/
